fields.name: generation_id
fields.description: Fund generation credited (blank when the shares sit outside any generation).

fields.name: vehicle_outside_fund_files
fields.description: Vehicle outside the fund files that holds the shares (single-company vehicles, general-partner entities, roll-over vehicles), or UNKNOWN.

fields.name: share_of_firm_stake
fields.description: Share of the firm's shares in the listing held by this generation or vehicle.

fields.name: primary_fraction
fields.description: Share of these shares counted as bought from the company.

fields.name: primary_value_usd_bn
fields.description: Primary value credited to this generation or vehicle. Unit: USD bn.

fields.name: value_end_usd_bn
fields.description: Value of these shares at the 2 October 2026 close, primary or not. Unit: USD bn.

fields.name: basis
fields.description: Evidence for the split: form3, form4, 13g, prospectus, ira (investors' rights agreement), 13f+ledger, press, name (holder name), rule (fund-vintage rule) and variants.

fields.name: basis_group
fields.description: Grouping of basis used in the report.

fields.name: split_source
fields.description: filing_research: per-fund filing research on large positions; manual: reconciled by hand from filings; rule: holder-name or vintage rule.
